page.metaDescription: Working draft of the BCSentinel terms of use.
page.title: Terms of Use
page.lead: Principles governing the use of BCSentinel, the Business Central extension, and related services.
page.tocAria: Terms of use table of contents
page.notice: These terms are a working draft and must be legally reviewed and aligned with the actual operator and contract structure before public sales or AppSource publication.

sections.title: 1. Scope and service description
paragraphs: BCSentinel combines a Business Central extension with a hosted backend, dashboard, findings, reports, and product-dependent access rights.
Results support decision-making and do not replace legal, tax, audit, or financial advice.

sections.title: 2. Product and access model
items: Free scan: limited preview without complete record details and monitoring capabilities
Assessment: unlocks the already generated complete analysis for seven days; no additional scan credit
Validation: one new scan credit followed by another seven days of full access
Monitoring: continuous full access with scheduled scans, history, trends, and monitoring capabilities for the active term

sections.title: 3. Customer responsibility
paragraphs: Customers remain responsible for reviewing results, model assumptions, Estimated Loss, and recommendations. Changes to Business Central data remain under customer control.

sections.title: 4. Prices, checkout, and terms
paragraphs: The prices, taxes, term, and payment conditions shown in checkout or an individual contract are authoritative.
Monitoring may run monthly or annually. Renewal and cancellation depend on the selected checkout or contract model.

sections.title: 5. Data and access rights
paragraphs: Processing is described in the privacy information. The registered tenant, environment, and company context determines access to protected content.

sections.title: 6. Availability and changes
paragraphs: BCSentinel may change as part of technical development. Maintenance, external services, and force majeure may temporarily affect availability.

sections.title: 7. Results and liability notice
paragraphs: Health Score, Estimated Loss, Potential Saving, findings, and reports depend on available data, checks, and documented assumptions. Business outcomes or savings are not guaranteed.
sections.note: Liability limits, warranties, governing law, and jurisdiction must be legally finalized before production sales.

sections.title: 8. End of access
paragraphs: Access may become limited when a time-limited right expires, a scan credit is consumed, or a Monitoring term ends. Retention and deletion follow privacy, contract, and operational requirements.

sections.title: 9. Contact
paragraphs: Questions about contracts, access, or the product can be submitted through Contact or support@bcsentinel.com.
